chart.settings.panMomentumHint: Keep gliding briefly after a drag release, and ease scroll-to-latest and keyboard pans.
chart.settings.revealOnLoadHint: Draw the candles in when a chart first loads. Takes effect on the next load.

indicator.accumulationDistribution.bearC: Line color while the A/D Line falls.
indicator.accumulationDistribution.bullC: Line color while the A/D Line rises.
indicator.accumulationDistribution.color: Color of the line when slope coloring is disabled or the line is flat.
indicator.accumulationDistribution.slope: Color the line by its slope — bullish while rising (accumulation), bearish while falling (distribution).
indicator.accumulationDistribution.title: Accumulation / Distribution
indicator.aroon.downColor.tooltip: Color of the Aroon Down line.
indicator.aroon.length.tooltip: Lookback length used to locate the highest high and lowest low.
indicator.aroon.title: Aroon
indicator.aroon.upColor.tooltip: Color of the Aroon Up line.
indicator.averageDirectionalIndex.adxCol: Color of the ADX line while it sits below the key level — no trend strong enough to trade.
indicator.averageDirectionalIndex.adxLen: Wilder RMA smoothing length applied to DX to obtain the ADX line.
indicator.averageDirectionalIndex.diLeng: Wilder RMA smoothing length applied to directional movement and true range when computing +DI and −DI.
indicator.averageDirectionalIndex.keyLev: Trend strength reference level; ADX above it is commonly read as a trending market.
indicator.averageDirectionalIndex.minusD: Color of the minus directional indicator, and of the ADX line above the key level while −DI leads.
indicator.averageDirectionalIndex.plusDi: Color of the plus directional indicator, and of the ADX line above the key level while +DI leads.
indicator.averageDirectionalIndex.title: Average Directional Index
indicator.averageTrueRange.color.tooltip: Color of the ATR line while volatility contracts or holds flat.
indicator.averageTrueRange.expandColor.t: Color of the ATR line while it rises — volatility expanding bar to bar.
indicator.averageTrueRange.length.toolti: Number of bars used to average the true range.
indicator.averageTrueRange.smoothing.too: Moving average applied to the true range. RMA is Wilder's original smoothing used by the classic ATR.
indicator.averageTrueRange.title: Average True Range
indicator.awesomeOscillator.fallingColor: Histogram color when the oscillator is lower than or equal to the previous bar.
Histogram color when the oscillator is higher than on the previous bar.
indicator.awesomeOscillator.title: Awesome Oscillator
indicator.awesomeOscillator.zeroColor.to: Color of the zero reference line.
indicator.balanceOfPower.bearColor.toolt: Line and fill color while the Balance of Power is below zero — sellers in control of the bar.
indicator.balanceOfPower.bullColor.toolt: Line and fill color while the Balance of Power is above zero — buyers in control of the bar.
indicator.balanceOfPower.color.tooltip: Color of the line at exactly zero.
indicator.balanceOfPower.smoothLength.to: Simple moving average length applied when smoothing is enabled.
indicator.balanceOfPower.smoothing.toolt: Smooth the raw Balance of Power with a simple moving average instead of plotting the single-bar value.
indicator.balanceOfPower.title: Balance of Power
indicator.bandwidth.bulgeColor.tooltip: Color of the highest-BandWidth reference line.
indicator.bandwidth.color.tooltip: Color of the BandWidth line. At its Squeeze reference the line takes the Squeeze color, at its Bulge reference the Bulge color.
indicator.bandwidth.gradientFill.tooltip: Fills the area between zero and BandWidth with a vertical gradient, fully transparent at zero.
indicator.bandwidth.lookback.tooltip: Window used to locate the lowest (Squeeze) and highest (Bulge) BandWidth references.
indicator.bandwidth.showBulge.tooltip: Plots the highest BandWidth of the reference lookback — extreme width that is unlikely to be sustained.
indicator.bandwidth.showSqueeze.tooltip: Plots the lowest BandWidth of the reference lookback — unusually compressed volatility, a condition rather than a directional signal.
indicator.bandwidth.squeezeColor.tooltip: Color of the lowest-BandWidth reference line.
indicator.bandwidth.title: Bollinger Bands Width
indicator.bollinger.length.tooltip: Number of bars used for the Bollinger Bands basis (a simple moving average) and for the standard deviation.
indicator.bollinger.mult.tooltip: Standard deviation multiplier for the upper and lower bands.
indicator.bollinger.source.tooltip: Price series the bands are computed from.
indicator.bollingerBands.basisColor.tool: Color of the basis (middle band) moving average.
indicator.bollingerBands.color.tooltip: Color of the upper and lower bands.
indicator.bollingerBands.fillColor.toolt: Fill color of the area between the upper and lower bands.
indicator.bollingerBands.length.tooltip: Number of bars used to calculate the basis SMA and the standard deviation.
indicator.bollingerBands.mult.tooltip: Number of standard deviations added above and below the basis to form the bands.
indicator.bollingerBands.source.tooltip: Price series the bands are calculated on.
indicator.bollingerBands.title: Bollinger Bands
indicator.chaikinMoneyFlow.bearColor.too: Line and fill color while the CMF reads below zero (net money flowing out).
indicator.chaikinMoneyFlow.bullColor.too: Line and fill color while the CMF reads above zero (net money flowing in).
indicator.chaikinMoneyFlow.color.tooltip: Color of the Chaikin Money Flow line.
indicator.chaikinMoneyFlow.length.toolti: Lookback length over which money flow volume and volume are summed.
indicator.chaikinMoneyFlow.title: Chaikin Money Flow
indicator.chaikinMoneyFlow.zeroColor.too: Color of the zero reference line.
indicator.chaikinOscillator.bearColor.to: Line and fill color while the oscillator reads below zero (distribution).
indicator.chaikinOscillator.bullColor.to: Line and fill color while the oscillator reads above zero (accumulation).
indicator.chaikinOscillator.color.toolti: Color of the Chaikin Oscillator line.
indicator.chaikinOscillator.fastLength.t: Length of the fast EMA applied to the accumulation/distribution line.
indicator.chaikinOscillator.slowLength.t: Length of the slow EMA applied to the accumulation/distribution line.
indicator.chaikinOscillator.title: Chaikin Oscillator
indicator.chaikinVolatility.color.toolti: Color of the Chaikin Volatility line.
indicator.chaikinVolatility.emaLength.to: Length of the exponential moving average applied to the bar high-low range.
indicator.chaikinVolatility.expansionCol: Line and fill color while the reading is above zero, when the smoothed range is wider than it was at the start of the ROC Length lookback.
indicator.chaikinVolatility.rocLength.to: Number of bars used for the rate of change of the smoothed high-low range.
indicator.chaikinVolatility.title: Chaikin Volatility
indicator.chandeKrollStop.longColor.tool: Color of the protective stop line for long positions.
indicator.chandeKrollStop.p.tooltip: Lookback used for both the ATR and the highest high / lowest low price extremes.
indicator.chandeKrollStop.q.tooltip: Lookback over which the preliminary stops are extended into the final stop levels.
indicator.chandeKrollStop.shortColor.too: Color of the protective stop line for short positions.
indicator.chandeKrollStop.title: Chande Kroll Stop
indicator.chandeKrollStop.x.tooltip: Multiplier applied to the ATR to offset the preliminary stops from the price extremes.
indicator.chandeMomentumOscillator.bearC: Line and fill color while momentum is negative, and shading of the overbought zone.
indicator.chandeMomentumOscillator.bullC: Line and fill color while momentum is positive, and shading of the oversold zone.
indicator.chandeMomentumOscillator.lengt: Number of bars over which up moves and down moves are summed.
indicator.chandeMomentumOscillator.level: Color of the overbought, oversold, and zero lines.
indicator.chandeMomentumOscillator.overb: Level above which the oscillator is considered overbought.
indicator.chandeMomentumOscillator.overs: Level below which the oscillator is considered oversold.
indicator.chandeMomentumOscillator.sourc: Price series used to measure bar-to-bar changes.
indicator.chandeMomentumOscillator.title: Chande Momentum Oscillator
indicator.chandelierExit.length.tooltip: Lookback used for both the highest high / lowest low extremes and the ATR.
indicator.chandelierExit.longColor.toolt: Color of the long trailing stop line.
indicator.chandelierExit.mult.tooltip: Multiple of ATR subtracted from the highest high (long stop) and added to the lowest low (short stop).
indicator.chandelierExit.ratchet.tooltip: Prevents the long stop from falling and the short stop from rising, resetting once close crosses through the stop.
indicator.chandelierExit.shortColor.tool: Color of the short trailing stop line.
indicator.chandelierExit.title: Chandelier Exit
indicator.channel.basisColor.tooltip: Color of the basis line while price sits exactly on it.
indicator.channel.bearColor.tooltip: Color of the upper band and of the basis while price sits below it.
indicator.channel.bullColor.tooltip: Color of the lower band and of the basis while price holds above it.
indicator.choppinessIndex.choppyColor.to: Line, fill and zone color toward and above the upper band — a choppy, range-bound market.
indicator.choppinessIndex.color.tooltip: Color of the Choppiness Index line.
indicator.choppinessIndex.fillColor.tool: Fill color of the zone between the upper and lower bands.
indicator.choppinessIndex.length.tooltip: Number of bars used to sum true ranges and to measure the highest high − lowest low range.
indicator.choppinessIndex.lowerBand.tool: Readings below this level indicate a strong trend.
indicator.choppinessIndex.title: Choppiness Index
Line, fill and zone color toward and below the lower band — a trending market.
indicator.choppinessIndex.upperBand.tool: Readings above this level indicate a choppy, range-bound market.
indicator.commodityChannelIndex.bearColo: Line and fill color while the CCI reads below zero.
indicator.commodityChannelIndex.bullColo: Line and fill color while the CCI reads above zero.
indicator.commodityChannelIndex.length.t: Number of bars used for the moving average and the mean absolute deviation of the source.
indicator.commodityChannelIndex.levelsCo: Color of the upper, lower and zero reference lines.
indicator.commodityChannelIndex.source.t: Price series measured by the CCI; the typical price hlc3 is the classic choice.
indicator.commodityChannelIndex.title: Commodity Channel Index
indicator.common.lineWidth.tooltip: Width of the plotted line, in pixels.
indicator.common.offset.tooltip: Bars the plotted line is displaced by. Positive values push it to the right.
indicator.connorsRsi.color.tooltip: Color of the Connors RSI line.
indicator.connorsRsi.levelsColor.tooltip: Color of the overbought and oversold levels.
indicator.connorsRsi.overboughtColor.too: Line, fill and zone color toward and above the overbought level.
indicator.connorsRsi.oversoldColor.toolt: Line, fill and zone color toward and below the oversold level.
indicator.connorsRsi.rankLength.tooltip: Lookback of the percent rank applied to the 1-bar rate of change of the closing price.
indicator.connorsRsi.rsiLength.tooltip: Length of the Wilder RSI applied to the closing price.
indicator.connorsRsi.streakLength.toolti: Length of the Wilder RSI applied to the up/down close streak.
indicator.connorsRsi.title: Connors RSI
indicator.coppockCurve.bearColor.tooltip: Line and fill color while the curve reads below zero.
indicator.coppockCurve.bullColor.tooltip: Line and fill color while the curve reads above zero.
indicator.coppockCurve.color.tooltip: Color of the Coppock Curve line.
indicator.coppockCurve.longRoc.tooltip: Lookback of the long rate of change, in bars. The original definition uses 14 monthly closes.
indicator.coppockCurve.shortRoc.tooltip: Lookback of the short rate of change, in bars. The original definition uses 11 monthly closes.
indicator.coppockCurve.source.tooltip: Price series used for the rate of change calculations.
indicator.coppockCurve.title: Coppock Curve
indicator.coppockCurve.wmaLength.tooltip: Length of the weighted moving average applied to the sum of the two rates of change.
indicator.coppockCurve.zeroColor.tooltip: Color of the zero reference line.
indicator.detrendedPriceOscillator.bearC: Color of the line and fill while the oscillator is below zero.
indicator.detrendedPriceOscillator.bullC: Color of the line and fill while the oscillator is above zero.
indicator.detrendedPriceOscillator.cente: Shifts the oscillator back by Length / 2 + 1 bars so it is centered on the prices it detrends. The most recent bars then show no value.
indicator.detrendedPriceOscillator.color: Color of the line when it sits exactly at zero.
indicator.detrendedPriceOscillator.lengt: Lookback of the simple moving average that price is detrended against. The comparison is displaced by Length / 2 + 1 bars.
indicator.detrendedPriceOscillator.sourc: Price series used in the detrending calculation.
indicator.detrendedPriceOscillator.title: Detrended Price Oscillator
indicator.detrendedPriceOscillator.zeroC: Color of the zero reference line.
indicator.donchianChannels.fillColor.too: Color of the channel interior fill.
indicator.donchianChannels.length.toolti: Lookback length. The upper and lower channels are the highest high and lowest low over this many bars.
indicator.donchianChannels.lowerColor.to: Color of the lower channel line.
indicator.donchianChannels.title: Donchian Channels
indicator.donchianChannels.upperColor.to: Color of the upper channel line.
indicator.easeOfMovement.bearColor.toolt: Color of the line and fill while Ease of Movement is negative.
indicator.easeOfMovement.bullColor.toolt: Color of the line and fill while Ease of Movement is positive.
indicator.easeOfMovement.color.tooltip: Color of the line when it sits exactly at zero.
indicator.easeOfMovement.divisor.tooltip: Volume scaling constant of the box ratio; larger values scale the oscillator up. 10000 is the conventional default.
indicator.easeOfMovement.length.tooltip: Number of bars in the simple moving average smoothing the 1-bar Ease of Movement values.
indicator.easeOfMovement.title: Ease of Movement
indicator.elderRay.bearColor.tooltip: Color of the Bear Power columns.
indicator.elderRay.bullColor.tooltip: Color of the Bull Power columns.
indicator.elderRay.length.tooltip: Number of bars in the exponential moving average of closing prices used as the reference level for Bull Power and Bear Power. Alexander Elder's classic setting is 13.
indicator.elderRay.title: Elder Ray
indicator.ema.length.tooltip: Number of bars used in the EMA calculation.
indicator.ema.source.tooltip: Price series the EMA is calculated on.
indicator.ema.title: Exponential Moving Average
indicator.fisherTransform.bearColor.tool: Color of the Fisher line and fill while it is below the trigger.
indicator.fisherTransform.bullColor.tool: Color of the Fisher line and fill while it is above the trigger.
indicator.fisherTransform.color.tooltip: Color of the Fisher line when it sits exactly on its trigger.
indicator.fisherTransform.length.tooltip: Lookback period used to locate the median price hl2 within its highest-lowest range. Ehlers' original length is 10; 9 is the common platform default.
indicator.fisherTransform.title: Fisher Transform
indicator.fisherTransform.triggerColor.t: Color of the trigger line, the Fisher value delayed one bar.
indicator.forceIndex.bearColor.tooltip: Color of the line while below zero (selling pressure).
indicator.forceIndex.color.tooltip: Color of the line while above zero (buying pressure).
indicator.forceIndex.length.tooltip: EMA length applied to the raw 1-bar force index, (close − close[1]) × volume. Elder used 13 for the intermediate trend and 2 for short-term timing.
indicator.forceIndex.title: Force Index
indicator.gatorOscillator.growColor.tool: Column color while a spread grew against its own previous bar — the averages are spreading apart.
indicator.gatorOscillator.jawLength.tool: Averaging length of the jaw line.
indicator.gatorOscillator.jawOffset.tool: Bars the jaw is displaced forward, 8 in the original recipe. The upper histogram measures the absolute spread between the displaced jaw and teeth.
indicator.gatorOscillator.lipsLength.too: Averaging length of the lips line.
indicator.gatorOscillator.lipsOffset.too: Bars the lips are displaced forward, 3 in the original recipe. The lower histogram measures the negative absolute spread between the displaced teeth and lips.
indicator.gatorOscillator.maType.tooltip: Moving average applied to the source for the jaw, teeth and lips. The original uses the smoothed (Wilder-style) moving average.
indicator.gatorOscillator.shrinkColor.to: Column color while a spread shrank — the averages are converging. Color encodes expansion, not trade direction.
indicator.gatorOscillator.source.tooltip: Price series fed to the three Alligator averages. Bill Williams' original recipe uses the median price (high + low) / 2.
indicator.gatorOscillator.teethLength.to: Averaging length of the teeth line.
indicator.gatorOscillator.teethOffset.to: Bars the teeth are displaced forward, 5 in the original recipe. The teeth line enters both spreads.
indicator.gatorOscillator.title: Gator Oscillator
indicator.gatorOscillator.zeroColor.tool: Color of the zero line separating the two histograms.
indicator.historicalVolatility.annualize: Scale the per-bar volatility to an annual figure by multiplying by the square root of the periods per year.
indicator.historicalVolatility.color.too: Color of the line at its recent highs; it fades toward grey as volatility contracts.
indicator.historicalVolatility.length.to: Lookback window in bars for the standard deviation of close-to-close log returns.
indicator.historicalVolatility.periodsPe: Number of periods in a year used for annualization: 252 for daily bars, 52 for weekly, 12 for monthly.
indicator.historicalVolatility.title: Historical Volatility
indicator.intradayIntensity.bearColor.to: Color of negative readings, the falling cumulative line and the fill below zero — the distribution side.
indicator.intradayIntensity.color.toolti: Color of positive readings, the rising cumulative line and the fill above zero — the accumulation side.
indicator.intradayIntensity.gradientFill: Fills the area between the zero line and the oscillator with a vertical gradient. Applies to the normalized oscillator only.
indicator.intradayIntensity.length.toolt: Window of the rolling sums in the normalized form. The common setting is 21 bars. It has no effect on the cumulative line.
indicator.intradayIntensity.mode.tooltip: The two published forms. The cumulative line is open-ended and read by slope against price; the normalized oscillator divides a rolling sum of intensity by the rolling sum of volume and oscillates around zero.
indicator.intradayIntensity.title: Intraday Intensity
indicator.keltnerChannels.atrLength.tool: Number of bars used to compute the Average True Range (Wilder smoothing).
indicator.keltnerChannels.length.tooltip: Number of bars used to compute the exponential moving average basis line.
indicator.keltnerChannels.mult.tooltip: ATR multiple used to offset the upper and lower bands from the basis line.
indicator.keltnerChannels.source.tooltip: Price series used to compute the basis line.
indicator.keltnerChannels.title: Keltner Channels
indicator.klingerOscillator.bearColor.to: Color of the Klinger oscillator while below zero.
indicator.klingerOscillator.color.toolti: Color of the Klinger oscillator while above zero.
indicator.klingerOscillator.fastLength.t: Length of the fast EMA applied to the volume force.
indicator.klingerOscillator.signalLength: Length of the EMA applied to the oscillator to obtain the signal line.
indicator.klingerOscillator.slowLength.t: Length of the slow EMA applied to the volume force.
indicator.klingerOscillator.title: Klinger Oscillator
indicator.knowSureThing.bearColor.toolti: Color of the KST line while below zero.
indicator.knowSureThing.bullColor.toolti: Color of the KST line while above zero.
indicator.knowSureThing.rocLength1.toolt: Lookback of the first (shortest) rate of change.
indicator.knowSureThing.rocLength2.toolt: Lookback of the second rate of change.
indicator.knowSureThing.rocLength3.toolt: Lookback of the third rate of change.
indicator.knowSureThing.rocLength4.toolt: Lookback of the fourth (longest) rate of change.
indicator.knowSureThing.signalLength.too: Simple moving average length of the signal line.
indicator.knowSureThing.smaLength1.toolt: Smoothing length applied to the first rate of change (RCMA #1).
indicator.knowSureThing.smaLength2.toolt: Smoothing length applied to the second rate of change (RCMA #2).
indicator.knowSureThing.smaLength3.toolt: Smoothing length applied to the third rate of change (RCMA #3).
indicator.knowSureThing.smaLength4.toolt: Smoothing length applied to the fourth rate of change (RCMA #4).
indicator.knowSureThing.title: Know Sure Thing
indicator.linearRegressionSlope.bearColo: Color of the slope line while the fit slopes downward.
indicator.linearRegressionSlope.bullColo: Color of the slope line while the fit slopes upward.
indicator.linearRegressionSlope.length.t: Number of bars used to fit the linear regression.
indicator.linearRegressionSlope.lineColo: Color of the slope line while the fit is flat.
indicator.linearRegressionSlope.source.t: Price series the regression is fitted to.
indicator.linearRegressionSlope.title: Linear Regression Slope
indicator.lsma.length.tooltip: Number of bars N in each least-squares fit. Every bar fits a straight line to its last N values and plots where that line ends, so the average leads turns that a same-length SMA trails, at the cost of overshooting after sharp moves.
indicator.lsma.offset.tooltip: Bars to step back along each bar's fitted line. 0 plots the line's endpoint at the current bar; larger values read the fit further back, trading lead for smoothness.
indicator.lsma.source.tooltip: Price series the regression line is fitted to.
indicator.lsma.title: Least Squares Moving Average
indicator.maEnvelope.length.tooltip: Number of bars in the basis moving average.
indicator.maEnvelope.maType.tooltip: Moving average type used as the envelope basis.
indicator.maEnvelope.percent.tooltip: Envelope offset as a percentage of the basis. Upper = basis × (1 + percent / 100), lower = basis × (1 − percent / 100).
indicator.maEnvelope.source.tooltip: Price series the basis moving average is calculated on.
indicator.maEnvelope.title: Moving Average Envelope
indicator.macd.fallAboveColor.tooltip: Histogram color when above zero and falling.
indicator.macd.fallBelowColor.tooltip: Histogram color when below zero and falling.
indicator.macd.growAboveColor.tooltip: Histogram color when above zero and rising.
indicator.macd.growBelowColor.tooltip: Histogram color when below zero and rising.
indicator.macd.signalLength.tooltip: Length of the EMA applied to the MACD line to obtain the signal line.
indicator.macd.source.tooltip: Price series used to compute the fast and slow EMAs.
indicator.macd.title: MACD
indicator.massIndex.armedColor.tooltip: Line color from the rise above the setup level until the decline below the trigger level.
indicator.massIndex.color.tooltip: Line color while no reversal bulge is armed.
indicator.massIndex.emaLength.tooltip: Length of the single EMA of the high-low range and of its double smoothing.
indicator.massIndex.length.tooltip: Number of bars over which the single/double EMA ratio is summed.
indicator.massIndex.setupLevel.tooltip: Reversal bulge setup level; a rise above it arms the pattern.
indicator.massIndex.title: Mass Index
indicator.massIndex.triggerLevel.tooltip: Reversal bulge trigger level; a decline below it after a setup completes the pattern.
indicator.moneyFlowIndex.color.tooltip: Color of the MFI line between the levels. Toward either level it blends into that level’s color.
indicator.moneyFlowIndex.fillColor.toolt: Fill color of the area between the overbought and oversold levels.
indicator.moneyFlowIndex.length.tooltip: Number of bars used to sum positive and negative money flow.
indicator.moneyFlowIndex.overbought.tool: Level above which the MFI is considered overbought.
indicator.moneyFlowIndex.overboughtColor: Color of the line and zone shading at and above the overbought level.
indicator.moneyFlowIndex.oversold.toolti: Level below which the MFI is considered oversold.
indicator.moneyFlowIndex.oversoldColor.t: Color of the line and zone shading at and below the oversold level.
indicator.moneyFlowIndex.title: Money Flow Index
indicator.movingAverage.almaOffset.toolt: ALMA type only. Values near 1 make the average more responsive, values near 0 make it smoother.
indicator.movingAverage.almaSigma.toolti: ALMA type only. Larger values widen the Gaussian window for a smoother average.
indicator.movingAverage.length.tooltip: Number of bars used in the MA 1 calculation.
indicator.movingAverage.lsmaOffset.toolt: LSMA type only. Bar offset applied to the linear regression value.
indicator.movingAverage.ma2Length.toolti: Number of bars used in the MA 2 calculation.
indicator.movingAverage.ma2Source.toolti: Price series MA 2 is calculated on.
indicator.movingAverage.ma2Type.tooltip: Moving average calculation used for MA 2.
indicator.movingAverage.maType.tooltip: Moving average calculation used for MA 1.
indicator.movingAverage.showMa2.tooltip: Displays the optional second moving average.
indicator.movingAverage.source.tooltip: Price series MA 1 is calculated on.
indicator.movingAverage.title: Moving Average
indicator.n52WeekHighLow.allTimeColor.to: Color of the all-time high and all-time low levels.
indicator.n52WeekHighLow.showAllTime.too: Additionally display the all-time high and low, tracked over the symbol's full loaded history.
indicator.n52WeekHighLow.title: 52-Week High/Low
indicator.n52WeekHighLow.weeks.tooltip: Length of the rolling window, in weeks.
indicator.negativeVolumeIndex.base.toolt: Arbitrary seed of the cumulative line, conventionally 1000. The absolute level carries no information — the line is read by slope and by position against the signal EMA.
Position vs Average colors the line by the classic regime read; Single Color draws the whole line in the neutral color.
indicator.negativeVolumeIndex.showSignal: Displays the conventional signal overlay. Hiding it only removes the plotted average; the regime coloring and fill still use it.
indicator.negativeVolumeIndex.signalLeng: Length of the signal EMA. The convention is 255 sessions on daily charts, about one trading year.
indicator.negativeVolumeIndex.title: Negative Volume Index
indicator.onBalanceVolume.maColor.toolti: Color of the smoothing MA line.
indicator.onBalanceVolume.maLength.toolt: Number of bars used for the smoothing MA.
indicator.onBalanceVolume.maType.tooltip: Moving average type used for the smoothing MA.
indicator.onBalanceVolume.smoothing.tool: Display a moving average of OBV to act as a smoothing/signal line.
indicator.onBalanceVolume.title: On Balance Volume
indicator.parabolicSar.bearColor.tooltip: Color of the SAR crosses while they sit above price — downtrend, the stop sits over the market.
indicator.parabolicSar.bullColor.tooltip: Color of the SAR crosses while they trail below price — uptrend, the stop sits under the market.
indicator.parabolicSar.increment.tooltip: Amount added to the acceleration factor each time the trend makes a new extreme point.
indicator.parabolicSar.maximum.tooltip: Upper cap on the acceleration factor.
indicator.parabolicSar.start.tooltip: Initial acceleration factor applied when a new trend begins.
indicator.parabolicSar.title: Parabolic SAR
indicator.percentB.bearColor.tooltip: Color of %B below the 0.5 midline, where price trades in the lower half of the bands.
indicator.percentB.bullColor.tooltip: Color of %B above the 0.5 midline, where price trades in the upper half of the bands.
indicator.percentB.gradientFill.tooltip: Vertical gradient between %B and the 0.5 midline, fully transparent at the midline and more opaque at the oscillator value.
indicator.percentB.levelsColor.tooltip: Color of the dashed overbought/oversold levels and of the dotted midline.
indicator.percentB.overbought.tooltip: Level treated as overbought. 1 is the upper band itself, so readings above the default mean price sits outside the bands.
indicator.percentB.oversold.tooltip: Level treated as oversold. 0 is the lower band itself, so readings below the default mean price sits outside the bands.
indicator.percentB.title: Bollinger Bands %B
indicator.pivotPoints.anchor.tooltip: Period the pivots are anchored to. Auto follows the chart's timeframe: daily pivots up to 15-minute bars, weekly on other intraday bars, monthly on daily bars, yearly above.
indicator.pivotPoints.kind.tooltip: Formula used to calculate the levels. Traditional is the classic floor-trader method; Fibonacci projects {level1, number}/{level2, number}/{level3, number}% of the prior range around the pivot; Camarilla scales the prior range around the prior close; Woodie gives extra weight to the period open.
indicator.pivotPoints.pivotColor.tooltip: Color of the central pivot (P) level.
indicator.pivotPoints.title: Pivot Points Standard
indicator.positiveVolumeIndex.base.toolt: Seed of the cumulative line. The absolute level carries no information, so the reads are the slope and the position against the signal EMA.
indicator.positiveVolumeIndex.showSignal: Plots the long EMA of PVI that anchors the classic regime read. Hiding it keeps the regime coloring and fill, which are always measured against it.
indicator.positiveVolumeIndex.signalLeng: Length of the signal EMA. The classic reference is 255 trading days on daily charts, about one year.
indicator.positiveVolumeIndex.source.too: Price series whose one-bar percentage change moves PVI on its active sessions.
indicator.positiveVolumeIndex.title: Positive Volume Index
indicator.ppo.bearColor.tooltip: Color of the PPO line, gradient fill and histogram below the zero line.
indicator.ppo.bullColor.tooltip: Color of the PPO line, gradient fill and histogram above the zero line.
indicator.ppo.fastLength.tooltip: Length of the fast moving average.
indicator.ppo.gradientFill.tooltip: Fills the area between the zero line and the PPO line with a vertical gradient.
indicator.ppo.maType.tooltip: Moving average type used for the fast and slow averages.
indicator.ppo.showHistogram.tooltip: Displays the histogram (PPO minus signal line) as columns. Bright columns mark a spread still widening, faded ones a spread narrowing back.
indicator.ppo.signalLength.tooltip: Length of the signal line that smooths the PPO line.
indicator.ppo.signalType.tooltip: Moving average type used for the signal line.
indicator.ppo.slowLength.tooltip: Length of the slow moving average. The spread is divided by it and scaled to a percentage of price.
indicator.ppo.source.tooltip: Price series fed into the fast and slow averages.
indicator.ppo.title: Percentage Price Oscillator
indicator.priceVolumeTrend.bearColor.too: Color of the PVT line while it falls bar to bar.
indicator.priceVolumeTrend.bullColor.too: Color of the PVT line while it rises bar to bar.
indicator.priceVolumeTrend.color.tooltip: Color of the PVT line while it is flat.
indicator.priceVolumeTrend.showSignal.to: Display a moving average of PVT acting as a signal line.
Number of bars used to compute the signal line.
indicator.priceVolumeTrend.signalType.to: Moving average type used for the signal line.
indicator.priceVolumeTrend.title: Price Volume Trend
indicator.pvo.bearColor.tooltip: Color of the oscillator and fill while participation contracts.
indicator.pvo.color.tooltip: Color of the oscillator and fill while participation expands.
indicator.pvo.fastLength.tooltip: Period of the fast EMA of volume. The conventional setting is 12.
indicator.pvo.showHistogram.tooltip: Plot the difference between the PVO and its signal line as columns behind the oscillator.
indicator.pvo.showSignal.tooltip: Plot the signal line, an EMA of the PVO.
indicator.pvo.signalLength.tooltip: Period of the EMA applied to the PVO to form the signal line.
indicator.pvo.slowLength.tooltip: Period of the slow EMA of volume. The PVO expresses the fast/slow spread as a percentage of this slow average.
indicator.pvo.title: Percentage Volume Oscillator
indicator.pvo.zeroColor.tooltip: Color of the zero reference line.
indicator.rateOfChange.bearColor.tooltip: Color of the line and fill while the reading is below zero.
indicator.rateOfChange.bullColor.tooltip: Color of the line and fill while the reading is above zero.
indicator.rateOfChange.color.tooltip: Color of the line when the reading sits exactly at zero.
indicator.rateOfChange.gradientFill.tool: Fills the area between the line and zero, following the line color.
indicator.rateOfChange.length.tooltip: Lookback period; the source is compared with its value this many bars ago.
indicator.rateOfChange.mode.tooltip: ROC % plots the change as a percentage of the source value from the lookback; Momentum plots the raw difference.
indicator.rateOfChange.source.tooltip: Series used as input for the calculation.
indicator.rateOfChange.title: Rate of Change
indicator.regime.bearColor.tooltip: Color of the line and gradient fill while it holds below its signal EMA.
indicator.regime.bullColor.tooltip: Color of the line and gradient fill while it holds above its signal EMA.
indicator.regime.gradientFill.tooltip: Fills the gap between the line and its signal EMA with a vertical gradient — transparent at the average, strongest at the line.
indicator.regime.neutralColor.tooltip: Color used while the signal EMA is still forming, or the line sits exactly on it.
indicator.regime.signalColor.tooltip: Color of the signal EMA overlay.
indicator.relativeVigorIndex.length.tool: Number of bars summed for the smoothed numerator (close − open) and denominator (high − low).
indicator.relativeVigorIndex.title: Relative Vigor Index
Color of the RVI line at the midline. Toward either threshold it blends into that threshold’s color.
indicator.relativeVolatilityIndex.overbo: Color of the line and zone shading at and above the overbought level.
indicator.relativeVolatilityIndex.overso: Color of the line and zone shading at and below the oversold level.
indicator.relativeVolatilityIndex.smooth: Number of bars used to smooth the up and down volatility streams.
Moving average applied to the volatility streams. EMA is Dorsey's classic calculation; Wilder (RMA) matches platforms that use Wilder smoothing.
indicator.relativeVolatilityIndex.stdevL: Number of bars used for the standard deviation of closing prices that serves as each bar's volatility reading.
indicator.relativeVolatilityIndex.title: Relative Volatility Index
indicator.rma.length.tooltip: Number of bars N in Wilder's smoothing: the line keeps (N − 1)/N of its previous value and blends in 1/N of the new price. That alpha is smaller than an EMA's, so an N-period RMA responds like a (2N − 1)-period EMA.
indicator.rma.source.tooltip: Price series the average smooths. Wilder computed his 1978 indicators on the close, but the recursion accepts any source.
indicator.rma.title: Smoothed Moving Average
indicator.rsi.color.tooltip: Color of the RSI line at the midline. Toward either threshold it blends into that threshold’s color.
indicator.rsi.fillColor.tooltip: Color of the fill between the overbought and oversold levels.
indicator.rsi.length.tooltip: Number of bars used in the Wilder smoothing of average gains and losses.
indicator.rsi.levelsColor.tooltip: Color of the overbought, midline and oversold levels.
indicator.rsi.overboughtColor.tooltip: Color of the line and zone shading at and above the overbought level.
indicator.rsi.oversoldColor.tooltip: Color of the line and zone shading at and below the oversold level.
indicator.rsi.source.tooltip: Price series the RSI is calculated on.
indicator.rsi.title: Relative Strength Index
indicator.schaffTrendCycle.bearColor.too: Color of the trend cycle line and gradient while the cycle holds the lower half of its 0-100 scale.
indicator.schaffTrendCycle.bullColor.too: Color of the trend cycle line and gradient while the cycle holds the upper half of its 0-100 scale.
indicator.schaffTrendCycle.cycleLength.t: Window of the two stochastic passes. Each pass measures where its input sits inside the range of its own values over this many bars.
indicator.schaffTrendCycle.factor.toolti: %D style recursive smoothing applied after each stochastic pass. 0.5 is the published default.
indicator.schaffTrendCycle.fastLength.to: Fast EMA length of the underlying MACD.
Vertical gradient between the midline and the trend cycle, fading out toward the midline.
indicator.schaffTrendCycle.levelsColor.t: Color of the dashed trigger lines and the dotted midline.
indicator.schaffTrendCycle.lower.tooltip: Lower trigger line. A cross up through it flags an emerging uptrend.
indicator.schaffTrendCycle.slowLength.to: Slow EMA length of the underlying MACD.
indicator.schaffTrendCycle.source.toolti: Price series used to build the MACD that the trend cycle is measured on.
indicator.schaffTrendCycle.title: Schaff Trend Cycle
indicator.schaffTrendCycle.upper.tooltip: Upper trigger line. A cross down through it flags an emerging downtrend.
indicator.slope.trendColor.tooltip: Colors the line by its slope — bullish while it rises, bearish while it falls. Disable to draw it in the neutral color.
indicator.sma.length.tooltip: Number of bars used in the SMA calculation.
indicator.sma.source.tooltip: Price series the SMA is calculated on.
indicator.sma.title: Simple Moving Average
indicator.smiErgodic.color.tooltip: Color of the SMI line while it sits exactly on its signal line.
indicator.smiErgodic.display.tooltip: Indicator plots the SMI and its signal line. Oscillator plots the difference between them as a histogram.
indicator.smiErgodic.fallColor.tooltip: Color of the falling oscillator histogram, and of the SMI line while it lags its signal.
indicator.smiErgodic.growColor.tooltip: Color of the rising oscillator histogram, and of the SMI line while it leads its signal.
indicator.smiErgodic.longLength.tooltip: Length of the first EMA smoothing applied to the momentum of the closing price.
indicator.smiErgodic.shortLength.tooltip: Length of the second EMA smoothing applied to the momentum of the closing price.
indicator.smiErgodic.signalLength.toolti: Length of the EMA of the SMI that forms the signal line.
indicator.smiErgodic.title: SMI Ergodic Oscillator
indicator.standardDeviation.color.toolti: Line color while volatility contracts or holds flat.
Line and fill color while volatility expands bar to bar.
indicator.standardDeviation.length.toolt: Number of bars used to compute the standard deviation.
indicator.standardDeviation.source.toolt: Price series the standard deviation is calculated on.
indicator.standardDeviation.title: Standard Deviation
indicator.stochastic.dLength.tooltip: Simple moving average length of the %D signal line, applied to the smoothed %K.
indicator.stochastic.fillColor.tooltip: Fill color of the area between the overbought and oversold levels.
indicator.stochastic.kLength.tooltip: Number of bars used for the highest high / lowest low range of the raw %K.
indicator.stochastic.kSmoothing.tooltip: Simple moving average length applied to the raw %K. 1 gives the fast stochastic, 3 the classic slow stochastic.
indicator.stochastic.title: Stochastic
indicator.stochasticRsi.dLength.tooltip: Simple moving average length applied to %K to form the %D signal line.
indicator.stochasticRsi.fillColor.toolti: Fill color of the area between the overbought and oversold levels.
indicator.stochasticRsi.kSmoothing.toolt: Simple moving average length applied to the stochastic of RSI to form %K.
indicator.stochasticRsi.rsiLength.toolti: Lookback length of the Wilder RSI.
indicator.stochasticRsi.source.tooltip: Price series the RSI is computed on.
indicator.stochasticRsi.stochLength.tool: Lookback over which the highest and lowest RSI values are taken.
indicator.stochasticRsi.title: Stochastic RSI
indicator.supertrend.atrLength.tooltip: Number of bars used to compute the Wilder ATR.
indicator.supertrend.downColor.tooltip: Line color while the trend is down.
indicator.supertrend.mult.tooltip: ATR multiplier setting how far the trailing stop sits from the bar midpoint.
indicator.supertrend.title: SuperTrend
indicator.supertrend.upColor.tooltip: Line color while the trend is up.
indicator.threshold.overbought.tooltip: Level above which the oscillator is considered overbought.
indicator.threshold.oversold.tooltip: Level below which the oscillator is considered oversold.
indicator.trix.bearColor.tooltip: Color of the TRIX line and its gradient fill while TRIX holds below zero.
indicator.trix.bullColor.tooltip: Color of the TRIX line and its gradient fill while TRIX holds above zero.
indicator.trix.length.tooltip: Length of each of the three EMA smoothing passes applied to the close price.
indicator.trix.signalLength.tooltip: Length of the EMA applied to TRIX to form the signal line.
indicator.trix.title: TRIX
indicator.trueStrengthIndex.bearColor.to: Color of the TSI line and its gradient fill while TSI holds below zero.
indicator.trueStrengthIndex.bullColor.to: Color of the TSI line and its gradient fill while TSI holds above zero.
indicator.trueStrengthIndex.longLength.t: Length of the first (long) EMA applied to the 1-bar price change.
Length of the second (short) EMA applied to the long-smoothed price change.
indicator.trueStrengthIndex.signalLength: Length of the EMA of TSI used as the signal line.
indicator.trueStrengthIndex.title: True Strength Index
indicator.ttmSqueeze.bbMult.tooltip: Standard deviation multiplier for the Bollinger Bands.
indicator.ttmSqueeze.bearColor.tooltip: Histogram color while momentum is negative. Bars building away from zero print solid, bars fading back print dimmed.
indicator.ttmSqueeze.bullColor.tooltip: Histogram color while momentum is positive. Bars building away from zero print solid, bars fading back print dimmed.
indicator.ttmSqueeze.kcMult.tooltip: ATR multiplier for the Keltner Channels. A smaller multiplier demands a tighter compression before the squeeze turns on.
indicator.ttmSqueeze.length.tooltip: Shared lookback for the Bollinger Bands, the Keltner Channels, and the momentum regression. John Carter's original setting is 20.
indicator.ttmSqueeze.markFires.tooltip: Draws a cross on the zero line on the first bar where the bands re-emerge outside the channels, colored by the side of the momentum histogram.
indicator.ttmSqueeze.source.tooltip: Price series used for the shared moving average basis, the standard deviation, and the momentum displacement.
indicator.ttmSqueeze.squeezeOffColor.too: Zero-line dot color while the Bollinger Bands trade outside the Keltner Channels.
indicator.ttmSqueeze.squeezeOnColor.tool: Zero-line dot color while both Bollinger Bands sit fully inside the Keltner Channels.
indicator.ttmSqueeze.title: TTM Squeeze
indicator.ulcerIndex.color.tooltip: Color of the index near zero; it blends toward the stress color as the reading approaches the threshold.
indicator.ulcerIndex.gradientFill.toolti: Vertical gradient between zero and the Ulcer Index, fully transparent at zero.
indicator.ulcerIndex.length.tooltip: Lookback window. At each bar the percentage drawdown from the window's running maximum is squared; the squares are averaged and the root taken.
indicator.ulcerIndex.showDrawdown.toolti: Plot the current percentage drawdown from the window high as columns below zero — the raw ingredient the index averages.
indicator.ulcerIndex.source.tooltip: Price series the Ulcer Index is computed on. Close is the standard choice.
indicator.ulcerIndex.stressColor.tooltip: Color of the index at and beyond the stress threshold.
indicator.ulcerIndex.threshold.tooltip: Reference level drawn as a dashed line. The index scales with the instrument's volatility and the window length, so set it relative to its own history.
indicator.ulcerIndex.thresholdColor.tool: Color of the stress threshold line.
indicator.ulcerIndex.title: Ulcer Index
indicator.ultimateOscillator.color.toolt: Color of the line midway between the levels. Toward either level it blends into that level’s color.
Bars in the fastest averaging window. Weighted 4 in the final blend, so it dominates the oscillator.
indicator.ultimateOscillator.levelsColor: Color of the overbought and oversold levels.
indicator.ultimateOscillator.middleLengt: Bars in the intermediate averaging window. Weighted 2 in the final blend.
indicator.ultimateOscillator.overboughtC: Color of the line at the overbought level and of the overbought zone shading.
indicator.ultimateOscillator.oversoldCol: Color of the line at the oversold level and of the oversold zone shading.
Bars in the slowest averaging window. Weighted 1 in the final blend.
indicator.ultimateOscillator.title: Ultimate Oscillator
indicator.vidya.adaptiveGradient.tooltip: Blends the trend color toward the flat color according to the adaptive scaler, so the line pales as momentum dies.
indicator.vidya.atrLength.tooltip: ATR window used to normalize VIDYA's one-bar slope, so the flat threshold behaves consistently across symbols and timeframes.
indicator.vidya.flatThreshold.tooltip: One-bar change of VIDYA, as a fraction of ATR, below which the line reads as flat.
indicator.vidya.length.tooltip: EMA-equivalent length N of the base smoothing constant, alpha = 2 / (N + 1). The adaptive scaler rescales this base speed bar by bar.
indicator.vidya.refLength.tooltip: Volatility mode only — window of the reference standard deviation the short-term reading is divided by.
indicator.vidya.scaler.tooltip: Bar-by-bar measure that rescales the smoothing constant. Momentum divides the absolute Chande Momentum Oscillator by 100; Volatility is Chande's original short-term over reference standard deviation.
indicator.vidya.scalerLength.tooltip: Lookback of the adaptive scaler — the CMO period in momentum mode, or the short-term standard deviation window in volatility mode.
indicator.vidya.source.tooltip: Price series the average smooths. VIDYA is classically computed on the close.
indicator.vidya.title: Variable Index Dynamic Average
indicator.vidya.trendColor.tooltip: Colors VIDYA by its regime read — bullish while sloping up beyond the flat threshold, bearish while sloping down, flat inside congestion.
indicator.volume.heightPct.tooltip: Panel height the tallest visible bar occupies.
indicator.volume.title: Volume
Color of the VFI line and gradient fill below the zero line — the net distribution regime.
indicator.volumeFlowIndicator.coef.toolt: Scales the volatility-based minimum change in typical price. Moves smaller than the cutoff count as noise and contribute no volume.
indicator.volumeFlowIndicator.color.tool: Color of the VFI line and gradient fill above the zero line — the net accumulation regime.
indicator.volumeFlowIndicator.gradientFi: Fills the area between the zero line and the VFI line with a vertical gradient.
indicator.volumeFlowIndicator.length.too: Rolling summation window, also used for the average volume that scales the result. The published default of 130 bars targets position-horizon work on daily charts.
indicator.volumeFlowIndicator.showSignal: Plots an EMA of VFI as a signal line.
indicator.volumeFlowIndicator.smooth.too: Applies the published light smoothing — an EMA of the summed line — before plotting.
indicator.volumeFlowIndicator.smoothLeng: Length of the smoothing EMA. The published version uses 3 bars.
indicator.volumeFlowIndicator.title: Volume Flow Indicator
indicator.volumeFlowIndicator.volCoef.to: Caps each bar's volume contribution at this multiple of the average volume, so a single climactic print stays bounded.
Window of the standard deviation of the log change in typical price used to build the adaptive cutoff.
indicator.volumeOscillator.bearColor.too: Color of the line and fill while it holds below zero — volume contracting.
indicator.volumeOscillator.color.tooltip: Color of the line and fill while it holds above zero — volume expanding.
indicator.volumeOscillator.fastLength.to: Length of the fast EMA of volume.
indicator.volumeOscillator.slowLength.to: Length of the slow EMA of volume.
indicator.volumeOscillator.title: Volume Oscillator
Color of the dotted baseline drawn at 1.
indicator.vortexIndicator.length.tooltip: Number of bars used to sum the vortex movements (VM+ and VM−) and the true range.
indicator.vortexIndicator.minusColor.too: Color of the negative vortex line (VI−).
indicator.vortexIndicator.plusColor.tool: Color of the positive vortex line (VI+).
indicator.vortexIndicator.title: Vortex Indicator
indicator.vpvr.title: Visible Range Volume Profile
indicator.vpvr.widthPct.tooltip: Panel width the largest row occupies.
indicator.vwap.anchor.tooltip: Period anchoring the average. VWAP and its bands reset on the first bar of each new session, week, month, quarter or year (UTC).
indicator.vwap.bandMult.tooltip: Multiplier for this band pair, in standard deviations or percent depending on the bands mode.
indicator.vwap.bandsMode.tooltip: Bands offset method: multiples of the volume weighted standard deviation of price around VWAP, or a percentage of the VWAP value.
indicator.vwap.bearColor.tooltip: VWAP line color while price closes below it, and the color of the upper (resistance) bands.
indicator.vwap.bullColor.tooltip: VWAP line color while price closes above it, and the color of the lower (support) bands.
indicator.vwap.fill.tooltip: Fill the area between each visible band pair.
indicator.vwap.hideDwm.tooltip: Hide the VWAP and its bands on daily and higher timeframes, where an intraday anchored VWAP is not meaningful.
indicator.vwap.source.tooltip: Price used in the volume weighted average. Typical price (HLC3) is the classic choice.
indicator.vwap.title: Volume Weighted Average Price
indicator.williamsAlligator.jawLength.to: Smoothing length of the Jaw SMMA of median price (hl2), 13 in the classic setup.
indicator.williamsAlligator.jawOffset.to: Number of bars the Jaw plot is shifted into the future, 8 in the classic setup.
indicator.williamsAlligator.lipsLength.t: Smoothing length of the Lips SMMA of median price (hl2), 5 in the classic setup.
indicator.williamsAlligator.lipsOffset.t: Number of bars the Lips plot is shifted into the future, 3 in the classic setup.
Smoothing length of the Teeth SMMA of median price (hl2), 8 in the classic setup.
Number of bars the Teeth plot is shifted into the future, 5 in the classic setup.
indicator.williamsAlligator.title: Williams Alligator
indicator.williamsFractal.downColor.tool: Color of the down fractal marker (swing low), drawn below the fractal bar.
indicator.williamsFractal.periods.toolti: Bars required on each side of the candidate bar. 2 is Bill Williams' classic 5-bar fractal; a fractal is confirmed only once this many later bars have closed.
indicator.williamsFractal.title: Williams Fractal
indicator.williamsFractal.upColor.toolti: Color of the up fractal marker (swing high), drawn above the fractal bar.
indicator.williamsPercentR.color.tooltip: Color of the %R line between the levels. Toward either level it blends into that level’s color.
indicator.williamsPercentR.length.toolti: Lookback length of the highest high / lowest low range. 14 is the classic setting.
indicator.williamsPercentR.overboughtCol: Color of the line and zone shading at and above the overbought level.
indicator.williamsPercentR.oversoldColor: Color of the line and zone shading at and below the oversold level.
indicator.williamsPercentR.source.toolti: Series located within the lookback range. Close is the classic choice.
indicator.williamsPercentR.title: Williams %R
indicator.zigzag.depth.tooltip: Minimum number of bars required between two consecutive pivots.
indicator.zigzag.deviation.tooltip: Minimum reversal from the leg extreme, as a percentage of that extreme, required to confirm a new pivot.
indicator.zigzag.title: ZigZag
indicator.zlema.length.tooltip: EMA length N. It sets both the smoothing (alpha = 2 / (N + 1)) and the correction: an EMA of length N lags by about (N − 1)/2 bars, and the de-lagging step is sized to cancel exactly that.
indicator.zlema.source.tooltip: Price series the average de-lags and then smooths.
indicator.zlema.title: Zero-Lag Exponential Moving Average
